sentences.pt: No sábado, Júlia ia mudar para um apartamento novo.
sentences.en: On Saturday, Júlia was going to move to a new apartment.

sentences.pt: Ela acordou às seis horas e tomou um café rápido.
sentences.en: She woke up at six o'clock and had a quick coffee.

sentences.pt: Os amigos Bruno e Rafael chegaram às sete para ajudar.
sentences.en: Her friends Bruno and Rafael arrived at seven to help.

sentences.pt: Primeiro, eles colocaram as roupas e os livros nas malas.
sentences.en: First, they put the clothes and the books in the suitcases.

sentences.pt: Depois, Bruno e Rafael carregaram o sofá pela escada.
sentences.en: Then, Bruno and Rafael carried the sofa down the stairs.

sentences.pt: O sofá era muito pesado, e Rafael quase caiu.
sentences.en: The sofa was very heavy, and Rafael almost fell.

sentences.pt: "Cuidado!", disse Júlia.
sentences.en: "Careful!" said Júlia.

sentences.pt: Bruno puxava e Rafael empurrava.
sentences.en: Bruno pulled and Rafael pushed.

sentences.pt: No caminhão, eles guardaram as cadeiras, a mesa e a cama.
sentences.en: In the truck, they put away the chairs, the table and the bed.

sentences.pt: Na estrada, o caminhão parou num semáforo, e um copo caiu e quebrou.
sentences.en: On the road, the truck stopped at a traffic light, and a glass fell and broke.

sentences.pt: "Não tem problema, é só um copo", disse Júlia, rindo.
sentences.en: "No problem, it's just a glass," said Júlia, laughing.

sentences.pt: No prédio novo, eles subiram com tudo pelo elevador.
sentences.en: At the new building, they went up with everything in the elevator.

sentences.pt: Júlia abriu a porta e entrou primeiro.
sentences.en: Júlia opened the door and went in first.

sentences.pt: O apartamento era pequeno, mas tinha uma janela grande.
sentences.en: The apartment was small, but it had a big window.

sentences.pt: Os três tiraram tudo das malas e arrumaram os quartos.
sentences.en: The three of them took everything out of the suitcases and tidied the rooms.

sentences.pt: A porta do banheiro estava quebrada, mas Bruno conseguiu consertar.
sentences.en: The bathroom door was broken, but Bruno managed to fix it.

sentences.pt: À noite, eles estavam muito cansados e com fome.
sentences.en: In the evening, they were very tired and hungry.

sentences.pt: Júlia pediu uma pizza, e eles comeram sentados no sofá.
sentences.en: Júlia ordered a pizza, and they ate sitting on the sofa.

sentences.pt: "Muito obrigada! Vocês são os melhores amigos do mundo", ela disse.
sentences.en: "Thank you so much! You're the best friends in the world," she said.

sentences.pt: Antes de dormir, ela olhou pela janela e se sentiu feliz na casa nova.
sentences.en: Before sleeping, she looked out the window and felt happy in her new home.

questions.q: O que eles comeram à noite?
questions.qEn: What did they eat in the evening?

sentences.pt: Na terça-feira, Thiago saiu do trabalho às seis e pegou o ônibus.
sentences.en: On Tuesday, Thiago left work at six and took the bus.

sentences.pt: Ele estava muito cansado e quase dormiu no ônibus.
sentences.en: He was very tired and almost fell asleep on the bus.

sentences.pt: Quando ele desceu no ponto, procurou o celular na mochila.
sentences.en: When he got off at the stop, he looked for his phone in his backpack.

sentences.pt: O celular não estava lá!
sentences.en: The phone wasn't there!

sentences.pt: Ele procurou na calça e na mochila de novo, mas não encontrou nada.
sentences.en: He looked in his pants and in his backpack again, but didn't find anything.

sentences.pt: Thiago ficou nervoso.
sentences.en: Thiago got nervous.

sentences.pt: "Eu esqueci o celular no ônibus!", ele pensou.
sentences.en: "I forgot my phone on the bus!" he thought.

sentences.pt: Ele correu até uma padaria e pediu para usar o telefone.
sentences.en: He ran to a bakery and asked to use the phone.

sentences.pt: Ele ligou para o próprio número, mas ninguém respondeu.
sentences.en: He called his own number, but nobody answered.

sentences.pt: "Esse ônibus volta daqui a quarenta minutos", explicou o homem da padaria.
sentences.en: "That bus comes back in forty minutes," explained the man from the bakery.

sentences.pt: Thiago esperou no ponto e contou os minutos.
sentences.en: Thiago waited at the stop and counted the minutes.

sentences.pt: Quando o ônibus chegou, ele subiu e falou com o motorista.
sentences.en: When the bus arrived, he got on and talked to the driver.

sentences.pt: "Desculpa, eu deixei meu celular aqui", ele disse.
sentences.en: "Sorry, I left my phone here," he said.

sentences.pt: O motorista riu e mostrou um celular preto.
sentences.en: The driver laughed and showed him a black phone.

sentences.pt: "Uma senhora encontrou isto embaixo de um banco", ele disse.
sentences.en: "A lady found this under a seat," he said.

sentences.pt: Thiago pegou o celular e disse: "Muito obrigado!"
sentences.en: Thiago took the phone and said: "Thank you very much!"

sentences.pt: Ele desceu do ônibus aliviado e voltou para casa andando.
sentences.en: He got off the bus relieved and walked back home.

sentences.pt: Em casa, ele contou a história para a esposa.
sentences.en: At home, he told the story to his wife.

sentences.pt: "Da próxima vez, guarde o celular na mochila!", ela disse, rindo.
sentences.en: "Next time, keep your phone in your backpack!" she said, laughing.

questions.qEn: Where did Thiago forget his phone?
How did Thiago feel in the end?
